newsitem.title: UK: N.Sea Aug crude liftings 4.45 mbpd, 4.44 in July.
newsitem.headline: N.Sea Aug crude liftings 4.45 mbpd, 4.44 in July.

text.p: August loading schedules for the eight main British and Norwegian oilfield systems released this week by operating companies show liftings will be little changed from July.

Daily liftings in August from Norway's Ekofisk, Gullfaks, Oseberg, Statfjord and Troll and Britain's Brent, Flotta and Forties systems are scheduled at 4.45 million barrels per day (bpd), just 10,000 bpb more than the revised 4.44 million bpd in July.
Lower output at Oseberg, Gullfaks, Brent and Troll will be balanced by higher flows from Flotta, Ekofisk and Forties, the figures show.
Initial expectations were for a bearish 245,000 barrel per day drop in output in August because of heavy maintenance programmes, mainly in the Norwegian sector.
That has been more than compensated by better than expected output from the Forties system, up more than three million barrels in August from July.
Total July loadings are due to turn out less than the forecast 4.49 million bpd because two Statfjord cargoes were delayed and one Flotta cancelled.
Traders noted planned maintenance would result in shutdowns on August 11-13, 18-20 and 23-25 at Norways's Mongstad crude terminal used to load Troll. The Mongstad refinery will be unaffected.
